articles.title: Ancient Galaxies Are Way Bigger Than We Thought!
articles.summary: Scientists found that some early galaxies may be 4 times more massive than we thought. They hid lots of small stars behind bright ones, like houses behind skyscrapers!

articles.title: Ancient Ship's Secret Waterproofing Recipe Revealed!
articles.summary: A 2,200-year-old Roman shipwreck shows how they waterproofed ships with pine tar and beeswax. Even pollen from the time was found stuck in the goo!

articles.title: Inside NASA's Astronaut Training Hub for the Future!
articles.summary: NASA's Johnson Space Center is getting ready for commercial space stations! We got a tour of Mission Control and saw how they're working with private companies.
